mekayis.metin: (أَكَدَ) الْهَمْزَةُ وَالْكَافُ وَالدَّالُ لَيْسَتْ أَصْلًا، لِأَنَّ الْهَمْزَةَ مُبْدَلَةٌ مِنْ وَاوٍ، يُقَالُ: وَكَّدْتُ الْعَقْدَ. وَقَدْ ذُكِرَ فِي بَابِهِ.

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: أَكَّدَ • (ʔakkada) II (non-past يُؤَكِّدُ (yuʔakkidu), verbal noun تَأْكِيد (taʔkīd))
g: to confirm, to corroborate (a view, report, fact, etc.)
to confirm, to ratify (an agreement, engagement, etc.)
to assert, to say (with certainty), to state as true
to affirm, to maintain (a belief, idea, etc.)
to bind firmly (a horse's or camel's saddle)
